{{short description|Season 13 of the US TV show}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=February 2012}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #FBAED2 | image = dwts13a.jpg | caption = Promotional poster, featuring former pro dancers [[Kym Johnson-Herjavec|Kym Johnson]] and [[Tristan MacManus]] | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Brooke Burke Charvet]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[J.R. Martinez]] | professional_winner = [[Karina Smirnoff]] }} | num_episodes = 20 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{start date|2011|9|19}} | last_aired = {{end date|2011|11|22}} }} '''Season thirteen''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on September 19, 2011, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network. Actor [[J. R. Martinez]] and [[Karina Smirnoff]] were crowned the champions, while [[Rob Kardashian]] and [[Cheryl Burke]] finished in second place, and talk show host [[Ricki Lake]] and [[Derek Hough]] finished in third. ==Cast== ===Couples=== Nine professional partners — [[Derek Hough]], [[Maksim Chmerkovskiy]], [[Cheryl Burke]], [[Tony Dovolani]], [[Mark Ballas]], [[Lacey Schwimmer]], [[Karina Smirnoff]], [[Anna Trebunskaya]], and [[Kym Johnson]] — returned this season. Maksim's brother, [[Valentin Chmerkovskiy]], made his debut competing as a professional. [[Peta Murgatroyd]] and [[Tristan MacManus]], part of season 12's troupe of dancers, also became professional partners for the first time.{{cite web |url=http://www.twitlonger.com/show/cnl8u3 |title=Tweet by DWTSGossip |publisher=Twitlonger.com |date=2011-08-29 |access-date=2012-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111020164405/http://www.twitlonger.com/show/cnl8u3 |archive-date=October 20, 2011 |url-status=live }} [[Louis van Amstel]] did not compete as a professional, but participated in a new segment called "Ballroom Battles",[https://twitter.com/LouisVanAmstel/status/98063817719808002 Tweet by Louis Van Amstel] which was cancelled on November 7.{{cite web |url=http://www.wetpaint.com/dancing-with-the-stars/articles/oops-dwts-cancels-new-ballroom-battle-segment- |title=Oops! DWTS Cancels New Ballroom Battle Segment - Dancing With The Stars |publisher=Wetpaint.com |date=2011-11-07 |access-date=2012-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111110152754/http://www.wetpaint.com/dancing-with-the-stars/articles/oops-dwts-cancels-new-ballroom-battle-segment- |archive-date=November 10, 2011 |url-status=live }} The dance troupe consisted of six dancers: [[Sharna Burgess]], Dasha Chesnokova, [[Oksana Dmytrenko]], [[Sasha Farber]], [[Kiki Nyemchek]], and Ted Volynets, plus the first eliminated male and female pros, who ended up being Val Chmerkovskiy and Peta Murgatroyd. This season featured twelve celebrity contestants. The cast was revealed during an episode of ''[[Bachelor Pad]]'' on August 28, 2011.{{cite web |url=http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars/cast-announcement/ThemeGallery/842916 |title=Cast announcement on |publisher=Abc.go.com |access-date=2012-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110923174442/http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars/cast-announcement/ThemeGallery/842916 |archive-date=September 23, 2011 |url-status=dead }} The twelve professionals were revealed on August 31, 2011 during ''[[Good Morning America]]''. Actor [[Ryan O'Neal]] was planning on competing as a celebrity, but could not after knee surgery, so [[Carson Kressley]] took his place.{{cite web |url=http://www.accesshollywood.com/_article_52788 |title=Injury Prevents Ryan O'Neal From Competing On 'Dancing With The Stars' |publisher=Accesshollywood.com |access-date=2012-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110909063229/http://www.accesshollywood.com/_article_52788 |archive-date=September 9, 2011 |url-status=live }} From the start, controversy erupted over the inclusion of [[Chaz Bono]], the child of singers [[Sonny Bono|Sonny]] and [[Cher]]. His appearance resulted in backlash from conservative supporters of the show, who even threatened to boycott due to his [[transgender]] status.{{cite web |author=TV |url=http://www.thewrap.com/tv/article/abc-hit-attacks-chaz-bono-after-dwts-casting-30586 |title=ABC Attacked by 'DWTS' Fans Over Chaz Bono Casting |publisher=Thewrap.com |date=2011-08-30 |access-date=2012-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111113044043/http://www.thewrap.com/tv/article/abc-hit-attacks-chaz-bono-after-dwts-casting-30586 |archive-date=November 13, 2011 |url-status=live }}{{cite web |url=http://www.ew.com/ew/gallery/0,,20326356_20556819,00.html#21098213 |title=Chaz Bono Causes a Rumba on Dancing With the Stars (Sept. 19) |publisher=Ew.com |date=2011-12-29 |access-date=2012-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120107194521/http://www.ew.com/ew/gallery/0,,20326356_20556819,00.html#21098213 |archive-date=January 7, 2012 |url-status=dead }} Despite the criticism, Bono received strong support from the [[LGBT]] community. It was stated in ''LGBT Weekly'' that "Bono has become the transgender community's living symbol of hope, strength and defiance against vitriolic hate. When ABC Television announced that Bono would appear on DWTS, he faced vile slurs and death threats from a group of trans-phobic women and men."{{cite web |author=THOM SENZEE, San Diego LGBT Weekly |url=http://lgbtweekly.com/2011/09/21/chaz-bonos-tv-appearance-sparks-dancing-boycott/ |title=Chaz Bono's TV appearance sparks 'Dancing' boycott |publisher=LGBT Weekly |access-date=2012-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111128172152/http://lgbtweekly.com/2011/09/21/chaz-bonos-tv-appearance-sparks-dancing-boycott/ |archive-date=November 28, 2011 |url-status=dead }} The controversy did lead producers to hire extra security protection for his time on the show.{{cite web |url=http://uk.ibtimes.com/articles/216873/20110920/dancing-with-the-stars-the-gay-lesbian-alliance-back-transsexual-chaz-bono-as-he-s-given-extra-secur.htm |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120718145136/http://uk.ibtimes.com/articles/216873/20110920/dancing-with-the-stars-the-gay-lesbian-alliance-back-transsexual-chaz-bono-as-he-s-given-extra-secur.htm |url-status=dead |archive-date=2012-07-18 |title=Dancing With the Stars: Transsexual Chaz Bono's Participation Stirs up Gender Controversy - Entertainment & Stars |publisher=Uk.ibtimes.com |date=2011-09-20 |access-date=2012-10-25 }} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align:center;" |- ! scope="col" | Celebrity ! scope="col" class="unsortable"| Notability ! scope="col" | Professional partner ! scope="col" | Status |- ! scope="row" | {{sortname|Ron|Artest}} |[[National Basketball Association|NBA]] small forward | {{sortname|Peta|Murgatroyd}} |style="background:#f4c7b8;"|Eliminated 1st
